title: Implement GROUP, NEXT, LAST, STAT
description:
Implement GROUP groupname: select group, return 211 with count/low/high/name, update session cursor. Implement NEXT: advance cursor to next article, return 223. Implement LAST: retreat cursor, return 223. Implement STAT [msgid|number]: return 223 without body. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/group.rs.

Acceptance:
- GROUP on unknown group returns 411
- GROUP on empty group returns 211 with count=0
- NEXT at end of group returns 421
- LAST at beginning of group returns 422
- Session state (current group, current article) persists across commands
